status.summary: Six straight UFC wins, the latest a first-round KO of Mauricio Ruffy with a standing elbow in the clinch at UFC 331 (Sep 19, 2026; 4:56 of R1), a fight he got after Charles Oliveira withdrew. No. 2 at lightweight and No. 13 pound-for-pound, widely seen as next for champion Justin Gaethje. Gaethje has named him as the opponent if he fights again but has not decided whether to retire. Nothing is booked as of Nov 6. On Nov 2 Tsarukyan said his next fight is a title fight, Gaethje or, if Gaethje retires, someone else; he would fight Alexander Volkanovski only with the belt at stake, and expects the UFC's answer by the end of November. Pro record 24-3.
status.ranking: #2 lightweight and #13 men's pound-for-pound (UFC media-panel rankings of Nov 3, 2026, as mirrored by UFCalendar and ufcrankings.org on Nov 5-6; ufc.com itself returned 403 to scripts)

signature: keeps shooting after misses: 10 takedown attempts in under 5 minutes vs Ruffy, 21 in 15 minutes vs Ismagulov
top control into ground strikes: 3 of his 5 UFC KO/TKOs are punches on the ground (Giagos, Alvarez, Joaquim Silva from mount)
standing elbow in the clinch (Ruffy KO, UFC 331)
early power at range: Dariush KO'd by a punch at distance at 1:04 of R1 (2023)
weaknesses: takedown accuracy is low: 35% career and 28% over the last 3 years
his two UFC losses are decisions to grapplers: Islam Makhachev in his 2019 debut and Mateusz Gamrot in a 2022 five-rounder (47-48 x3)
concedes submission attempts: Oliveira threatened 4 at UFC 300 (while Tsarukyan held 8:41 of control) and Hooker 2; 3.0 opponent submission attempts per 15 min over 3 years (league 0.40)
long gaps: 19 months between UFC 300 (Apr 2024) and Hooker (Nov 2025), then 10 months to Ruffy
only one fight has gone five rounds (the Gamrot loss), so late-round evidence is thin
style.summary: A wrestle-boxer who wins by getting the fight down and keeping it there. He shoots about twice as often as the average lightweight, rides top position and lands most of his damage on the ground, but he carries stand-up power too (Dariush, Ruffy). In 13 UFC fights he has never been knocked down. His two losses are close decisions to elite grapplers.

moves.notes: Weights are normalized to sum to 1 within the head, body and leg groups, as the director's picker expects (fact-check, Nov 6, 2026; ratios unchanged). Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 79% head, 13% body, 8% legs (landed 71/18/11), close to the lightweight league's 76/15/9 but lighter on the body and legs, so kicks stay low. Much of his landed output is ground strikes: 35% of landed strikes decayed and 44% over the last 3 years, which these standing weights do not cover. Elbow is raised because the Ruffy KO was a standing elbow in the clinch (MMA Weekly, MMA Mania; ufcstats: 'Elbow to Head In Clinch'). The rear hand gets the top punch weight because the Dariush finish was a punch at distance in the first minute; the hand is not recorded, so this is a judgment. His striking mostly serves to set up his shots: 9.4 takedown attempts per 15 min career.

The 2026 look matches the 2019 photo in kind, with a fuller beard and a longer, swept-back top. Light body hair on the chest and legs. Kit varies by fight and the corner colour wins in the sim.

engine_notes.note: Chin: 0 knockdowns absorbed in 13 UFC fights. He absorbs 1.77 significant strikes per minute career and 1.18 over 3 years (league 4.32). The small sample (168 head strikes absorbed) means the chin should be shrunk toward the league.
Wrestling volume: 9.4 takedown attempts per 15 min career (10.6 decayed) at 35%, against a league 4.3 at 36%. Control is 387 s per 15 min career and 462 decayed (league 174).
Power: 1.63 knockdowns per 100 significant head strikes landed decayed (league 0.95); 4 knockdowns scored in 13 UFC fights.

Opponents threaten submissions against him far more than the league norm: 3.0 per 15 min over the last 3 years (0.40 league), over a small sample (4 fights). Oliveira threw 4 of them at UFC 300 in a fight where Tsarukyan held 8:41 of control.
Gaethje has said that if he fights again it will be against Tsarukyan (late Sep 2026). The UFC is reportedly working on that fight, per an unnamed insider (low-medium confidence).
Background injury: he withdrew from a UFC 311 title fight with Islam Makhachev the day before the event (Jan 2025) with a back injury; Renato Moicano replaced him.
